title: parse_sse_block uses .trim() on id: value; RFC 8895 §9.1 says strip exactly one leading space
description: RFC 8895 §9.1 says 'If the line contains a U+003A COLON character (:), collect the characters up to but not including the first U+003A COLON character, and let field be that string. Collect the characters after the first U+003A COLON character, and let value be that string. If value starts with U+0020 SPACE, remove it from value.' strip_prefix() + .trim() removes ALL leading and trailing whitespace from the id value, not just one leading space. An id that legitimately begins or ends with spaces (unusual but spec-valid) would be silently mangled. Also affects data: lines. Consistent with how most SSE implementations handle this in practice, but is a spec deviation that could generate a support issue.
